newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs down amid weak NYMEX futures.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs down amid weak NYMEX futures.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were steady to weaker in quiet trade on Friday amid continued weakness in NYMEX futures, players said.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, propane remained between 34.75 cents and 35.00 cents a gallon. 35.125-cent deals were done.
Conway, Kansas, hub material was also largely steady at 36.50/36.75 cents. A 35.25 cent deal was done.
Conway normal butane was down 0.75 cent at 38.00/38.25 cents. Belvieu material was steady.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
